data.name: Aquata - 6 Hour Charter
data.headline: Up to 11 People • The All-Weather Performer • Luxury and Speed!
data.description:
#A Private Charter on the Best Cruiser in San Diego!

##Schedule
Monday - Sunday
Year Round
6 hour charters available between 8am-10pm

Our charter perfectly combines the speed of a racing boat, coupled with the luxury and comfortability of a modern yacht. Aquata is equipped with a salon-style bedroom, bathroom, and forward and aft lounge areas. Too much sun? Enter the cabin equipped with an electronic sunroof and ice-cold air conditioning while gazing out of our panoramic glass windows. We specialize in bachelorette/bachelor parties, date night, birthday bashes, family/friend outings and much more! We thought of everything to make your outing perfect, so you don’t have to!

data.cancellation_notes:
2025 Bookings: Private Charters have a 2-week cancellation policy. To receive a full refund of your deposit you must cancel your reservation 2 weeks prior to the event. If canceled within the 2 weeks you will forfeit your deposit. You have the option to reschedule at no charge up until 72 hours prior to departure. Your reservation is not eligible for a refund 72 hours prior to your event.

2026 Bookings: Private Charters have a 3-week cancellation policy. To receive a full refund of your deposit you must cancel your reservation 3 weeks prior to the event. If canceled within the 3 weeks you will forfeit your deposit. You have the option to reschedule at no charge up until 1 week prior to departure. Your reservation is not eligible for a refund 1 week prior to your event.

Aquata we will go out rain or shine unless the captain deems conditions unsafe to be on the water. If he makes that decision you will be contacted by a team member to go over your options to rebook.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for choosing Aquata Charters! We are so excited to have you aboard! Please review the details below including parking and walking directions to get to the boat. 

###Parking Directions:
When you hit our address 2700 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego 92106 you will see a large parking lot on the right located in front of the Brigantine restaurant. For free parking, please park in the rear of the parking lot as there are no meters. We do not have assigned parking, so please be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes prior to departure. Google Maps: [Triton Charters](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Triton+Charters/@32.7213411,-117.2299103,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deab7fd72e5973:0x221232ad56159d50!8m2!3d32.7213366!4d-117.2277216)

###Walking Directions:
Once parked cross to the other side of the street on Shelter Island Drive and the path to the docks has yellow markers on the corner. The dock path is located between Intrepid Boat Works and San Diego Marine Exchange. Once on the dock path the boat is located at the first black gate. **Check-in will be directly at the gate.** Please fill out your waivers prior to arrival! 

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/rXhbCouuQ7qUkprVUEh3)

## Cruise Features
- Coast Guard certified captain to assist you on your charter ($50/hr paid directly to the captain prior to leaving the dock)
- Cruise into the San Diego Bay to check out the Coronado Bridge, USS Midway and Star of India! If time permits cruise up to Mission Bay to explore the different coves!
- Aquata offers a small cooler filled with ice and a mini fridge to store drinks. We will provide some soft drinks and water bottles. You are welcome to bring your own food and drinks on board!
- Speeds of up to 55mph, chill or thrill your way around San Diego!
- 1 two person cabin 
- 1 private bathroom with shower
- Sun loungers on the bow and stern
- A professional Bluetooth sound system 
- Fully enclosed waterproof cabin with a table and cushioned seating
- Anchor and swim! Snorkel equipment and inflatable paddle-boards included
- Easy access from the dock onto the boat

###Private Charter Details
- Now that your charter is confirmed an Event Coordinator will reach out to go over food and beverage options and will be sending your proposal and contract. Please make sure to sign your contract upon receiving as this confirms the booking and allows us to start the planning process. 
- With a private event you have the option to customize your charter to fit your needs. We have great preferred vendors and water toy add-ons! Your coordinator will be your direct point of contact and is happy to answer any questions and provide additional information regarding your charter.

###Please note:
- You must arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes before your charter time. Check in will be directly at the boat. Please have your guests fill out their waivers prior to arrival, and have ID's handy before you arrive! 
- Film Production and Drone Filming are prohibited without approval. 
- Jumping off the boat without approval will forfeit your charter. 
- Any illegal or lewd activities will automatically end and forfeit your charter. 
- No smoking is allowed on board.
- Intoxicated passengers are not allowed to board the yacht.
- No animals are allowed on board.
- Aquata is sanitized before, during, and after every charter.
- No red wine allowed on board.
- Please limit the glass being brought on the boat. We understand if you have a bottle of wine or liquor bottle but if you are bringing beers please make sure they are in cans. Glass will need to stay in the indoor lounge and you can not walk around the boat with any glass.
